## Governed change

- Linear issue:
- Change packet / policy version: `p5-m58-change-packet/v1` / `P5-M5.8-OPERATIONS-FREEZE-v1`
- Exact base commits: content / Lean / site / mathlib
- Fact families changed:
- Author role and actor ID:
- Reviewer role(s) and actor ID(s):
- Attribution: source references / contributor actor IDs
- Canonical source SHA-256 (when editorial/translation changes):

## Authority and review

- [ ] Every edit is in its canonical repository.
- [ ] Mathematical/editorial review is recorded when advancing to `current_reviewed`.
- [ ] Semantic review records exact FART/FLOC/FLINK and Lean/mathlib revisions.
- [ ] Translation source revision and freshness state are exact.
- [ ] Stale translation disclosure/fallback and unavailable route suppression are explicit.
- [ ] Classification coverage uses a current, license-qualified snapshot or an explicit missing state.
- [ ] Author and required reviewer are distinct.
- [ ] Generated files were regenerated and were not hand-edited.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm generate`
- [ ] `pnpm validate`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm check:generated`
- [ ] Valid, invalid, missing, stale and incompatible behavior was considered.
- [ ] Accessibility and text-only review evidence remain complete.
- [ ] Deployment remains unauthorized.
